name: 68502 · Lincoln, NE
findings: ZIP 68502 (Lincoln) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68502 (Lincoln) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68502 (Lincoln) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).
